crew.overview: Following the murder of her father by a hired hand, a 14-year-old farm girl sets out to capture the killer. To aid her, she hires the toughest U.S. Marshal she can find—a man with 'true grit'—Reuben J. 'Rooster' Cogburn.
crew.title: True Grit

details.biography: David O. Rogers has worked in film and television post-production for over 25 years, learning the business as an assistant editor on projects large and small: Men in Black, Chinese Coffee, Garden State, The Stepford Wives, The Night Of. He has also written, directed, and edited several short films, including The Light of Eons (winner of best short at Westchester Film Fest). He has recently stepped into the editor’s role in films and episodic shows, including Halston (Netflix, as additional editor), the indie feature No Name Restaurant (Enigma Film), and Ripley (Netflix), earning him an Emmy nomination for editing.
details.name: David O. Rogers
